note_en: 连…也/都… means "even": 连电池容量也升级了不少 "even the battery capacity had been upgraded considerably." English just puts "even" in front of the noun, but Chinese frames the noun with 连 before it and 也 or 都 before the verb, and the 连 phrase always comes before the verb, as in 连充电速度也比上一代快了将近一倍.
